source.documentary_posture: Every OpenAPI leaf points directly at its immutable raw official contract. The finite RPC leaf instead records both immutable protobuf documents and the official SDK Connect-JSON wire choice; it does not mislabel protobuf as OpenAPI.

contract_gaps.deprecated_operations: Seven operations explicitly deprecated by the current control-plane contract are excluded because each has a current replacement. They remain in the fixture so contract coverage is total rather than silently narrowed.
contract_gaps.binary_uploads: Volume file PUT requires application/octet-stream and envd file POST requires multipart/form-data. The current REST adapter has no caller-file request binding, so both uploads are excluded while both binary GET downloads use file_ref capture.
contract_gaps.envd_bootstrap: POST /init is a host-controlled bootstrap seam that can replace envd authentication and routing metadata. Exposing it as a user operation would cross the official public/runtime boundary and weaken fail-closed credential handling.
contract_gaps.connect_json: The official JavaScript SDK creates a Connect transport with useBinaryFormat false. Thirteen unary methods are therefore emitted as POST application/json with Connect-Protocol-Version: 1; four streaming methods remain excluded.
contract_gaps.envd_routing: The official SDK uses https://sandbox.e2b.app with E2b-Sandbox-Id and E2b-Sandbox-Port routing headers in supported server runtimes. Envd connections are deliberately sandbox-scoped and require X-Access-Token even where the envd OpenAPI also permits anonymous access.
contract_gaps.account_auth: Account operations select the official AuthProvider bearer alternative. Team-scoped operations additionally expose a required X-Team-ID header argument instead of storing a mutable team selector inside the bearer connection.
contract_gaps.volume_auth: The control-plane create/get volume response returns the volume-scoped token that the official SDK stores on Volume and sends as the VolumeJWT bearer at https://api.e2b.app. It remains a distinct connection because this is not the control-plane X-API-Key.
contract_gaps.rpc_user_scope: Authorization is a gateway-locked credential header, so it cannot honestly be exposed as an operation argument. The dedicated e2b_envd_rpc connection carries the official SDK Basic base64(username:) user scope alongside the sandbox ID and envd access token; Basic dXNlcjo= selects the default user.
contract_gaps.exact_request_integers: Every admitted JSON or Connect body is sent as literal body_raw, and scalar path/query integers are emitted from exact decimal-string arguments. Neither route converts an integer literal through JavaScript Number.
contract_gaps.exact_response_integers: Every admitted application/json response uses unsafe_integers=string. Connect int64 values are already strings by protocol, and the same parser setting keeps any other unsafe literals exact.
contract_gaps.pagination: Documented page and cursor selectors are exposed, but the suite declares no generic paginator because E2B uses endpoint-specific nextToken, cursor, time-window, and limit contracts.
contract_gaps.sources: Sandboxes, templates, volumes, nodes, filesystem entries, and processes are infrastructure/runtime resources. None establishes an honest task, note, or project list/read/version contract, so no Source is declared.

source_eligibility.evidence: E2B executes code and manages infrastructure; no admitted contract defines a canonical work task with stable list/read/version semantics.
Logs, environment variables, and filesystem files are runtime artifacts rather than canonical note records.
Templates and sandboxes are executable infrastructure resources, not user project records with proven sync and version semantics.
